name: genspark-master
description: Genspark multi-account pool, parallel batch chat/image, interactive gsk menu and MCP tools for Codex

interface.shortDescription: Multi-account Genspark: auto-failover, parallel batch, guided login.
interface.longDescription: Chat and generate images through browser-authenticated Genspark accounts. Add several accounts (gsk accounts), route round-robin with automatic quota failover, run large jobs in parallel (batch_chat, batch_generate_images), and manage everything from an interactive gsk menu with first-run onboarding.
defaultPrompt: Set up my Genspark accounts with gsk.
Run these prompts in parallel across my Genspark accounts.
Generate 3 image concepts in parallel with Genspark.
